# compoundcalc.ai

## About
CompoundCalc.ai is a free compound interest calculator. Calculate investment growth, savings projections, and compare different compounding frequencies.

## URLs
- Homepage: https://compoundcalc.ai/
- Compound vs Simple Interest article: https://compoundcalc.ai/articles/compound-vs-simple/
- Beginner's Guide to Compound Interest: https://compoundcalc.ai/articles/beginners-guide/

## Languages
Available in English (/), German (/de/), Spanish (/es/), French (/fr/), Portuguese (/pt/), Chinese (/zh/), Japanese (/ja/), Hindi (/hi/), Arabic (/ar/), Russian (/ru/), and Turkish (/tr/). Articles have translations at /articles/<slug>/<lang>/.
